<template>
	<AsamButton type="default" @click="open = true">开始导览</AsamButton>

	<AsamDivider />

	<AsamSpace>
		<AsamButton type="default" ref="ref1">上传</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton ref="ref2" type="default">保存</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" ref="ref3" :icon="MoreFilled" />
	</AsamSpace>

	<AsamTour v-model="open" type="primary" :mask="false">
		<AsamTourStep :target="ref1?.$el" title="上传文件" description="将文件放在这里。" />
		<AsamTourStep :target="ref2?.$el" title="保存" description="保存修改" />
		<AsamTourStep :target="ref3?.$el" title="其他操作" description="点击查看其他内容" />
	</AsamTour>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamDivider, AsamSpace, AsamTour, AsamTourStep } from '@asam-ui/ui';
type ButtonInstance = InstanceType<typeof AsamButton>;
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { MoreFilled } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';

const ref1 = ref<ButtonInstance>();
const ref2 = ref<ButtonInstance>();
const ref3 = ref<ButtonInstance>();

const open = ref(false);
</script>
